src/copy/PACREQ.cpy: * ZOS-6 (ZV-D33, Z4): REQ-PMODE = PARM COLUMN 26, SET ONCE BY
* PACMAIN: C = PRESENT(COALESCED) (PHYSICAL WRITES COALESCED BY
* PACPLAT PSLT), ANYTHING ELSE = EVERY QUANTUM WRITTEN (D33).
* REQ-PRES: PSLT IN B (BASE: START / RESUME QUANTUM) OR Q, OUT Y
* (PRESENT THIS QUANTUM) OR N (COALESCED: NO SCREEN, NO WRITE).
src/cobol/PACMAIN.cob: * ZOS-6 (ZV-D33, Z4): COLUMN 26 = PRESENT: C COALESCED, ANYTHING
* ELSE / ABSENT EVERY (D33: ONE WRITE PER QUANTUM, UNCHANGED).
* EACH RUNNING QUANTUM: A INPUT (RT-COLLECT), S PACRT RQ, D
* PACPLAT PSLT (PRESENT IT: Y / N), R PACDISP RTQF (N: SCREEN
* STATE ONLY), W THE WRITE (Y), B COALESCED TSC ONLY AFTER A
* WRITE: EXACTLY ONE NON-BLOCKING READ (ONE TGET), ITS EVENT IS
* FOR THE NEXT QUANTUM, T THE DEADLINE (WDLN). START AND RESUME
* QUANTA ARE BASES (ALWAYS PRESENTED). AN ENTER / INVALID / PA2
* PROMPT FRAME WAITS FOR THE NEXT PRESENTED QUANTUM.
* ZOS-6 PHASE B (COALESCED TSC, RIGHT AFTER A PRESENTED WRITE):
* EXACTLY ONE RTRD = ONE PACPLAT POLL = ONE TGET ASIS,NOWAIT (NO
* DRAIN LOOP). ITS EVENT GOES TO PACRT RIN NOW, SO IT IS AN INPUT
* OF THE NEXT QUANTUM (BEFORE THAT QUANTUM'S OWN A READS); THE
* STEP AND THE FRAME OF THIS QUANTUM ARE ALREADY DONE.
src/cobol/PACPLAT.cob: * ZOS-6 (ZV-D33, Z4): PSLT = THE PRESENTATION SLOT OF A RUNNING
* REALTIME QUANTUM, IN LOGICAL TIME (NEVER THE WALL CLOCK): Y
* UNLESS REQ-PMODE C AND TSC / TSD; THEN REQ-PRES B (START /
* RESUME QUANTUM) = Y AND PS-ACC 0; ELSE PS-ACC + REQ-RTPER, Y
* WHEN IT REACHES PS-TP (300 MS, PROBE PR2-A) AND PS-ACC BACK TO
* 0 (RESET, NOT SUBTRACT: NO CATCH-UP), ELSE N. NORMAL (150): A
* WRITE EVERY 2ND QUANTUM, FAST (125): EVERY 3RD (375 MS).
IF REQ-MODE NOT = 'TSC' AND REQ-MODE NOT = 'TSD'
src/cobol/PACDISP.cob: * ZOS-6 (ZV-D33, Z4): RTQF WITH REQ-PRES N (A COALESCED QUANTUM,
* TSC / TSD) = SCR-RTQS: NO SCREEN, NO SEND; PACSCR RTQS ADVANCES
* THE DISPLAY STATE OF LOGICAL TIME (FACING, POPUP) AND THE S2
* PATTERN CLOCK COUNTS THE QUANTUM (PT-NEXT DOWN TO 1 AT MOST: A
* STEP DUE ON A SKIPPED QUANTUM RINGS ON THE NEXT WRITE). THE
* BELL SNAPSHOT, METRICS AND THE SCREEN IMAGE ADVANCE ONLY WITH
* ZOS-6: A COALESCED QUANTUM (SEE THE HEADER).
src/cobol/PACSCR.cob: * ZOS-6 (ZV-D33, Z4): OP RTQS = A COALESCED (NOT PRESENTED)
* REALTIME QUANTUM: ONLY THE DISPLAY STATE THAT FOLLOWS LOGICAL
* TIME ADVANCES - RP-STATE (POPUP START / CELL / EXPIRY AT THIS
* QUANTUM), SET-FACE (FACING FROM THIS STEP) AND, ANIM Y, VIS =
